_readme: Vector Hoops player-identity registry. person_id is the stable identity key for every real person in the dataset. NEVER key identity on display names: suffixes (Jr/Sr/II/III/IV) were stripped upstream, which merged 12 distinct NBA careers into shared names. pipeline/apply_player_identity.py stamps person_id + corrected display names onto assets; pipeline/qa_player_identity.py hard-fails the build on any unregistered name collision or unexplained season gap.

_lesson.what: Player identity was keyed on suffix-stripped display names, so 12 distinct NBA careers (Tim Hardaway Sr./Jr., Gary Payton / Gary Payton II, Gary Trent / Gary Trent Jr., Jaren Jackson / Jaren Jackson Jr., Jabari Smith / Jabari Smith Jr., Glenn Robinson / Glenn Robinson III, Ron Harper / Ron Harper Jr., two Reggie Williamses, two Dee Browns, two Mike Jameses, two Chris Johnsons) were merged into shared names. Career Trails, Insights and twin matching all treated fathers and sons as one player.
_lesson.attribution: recipe problem: pipelines normalized display names and stripped Jr/Sr/II/III/IV for matching, and no required step established person identity or challenged suffix stripping.
_lesson.fix: This registry is the single reviewed source of person identity (stable person_id, corrected display names, season-verified splits, comeback allowlist). The applier stamps person_id onto every player-season row and remaps name-keyed assets; consumers group by person_id; the QA gate fails the build on any unregistered collision or unexplained gap.
_lesson.prevents: Any future same-name player (father/son, Jr./Sr.) can never silently merge again: the gate fails unless the collision is reviewed and registered here.
_lesson.confidence: high: all 12 splits verified against season-level game counts and external references; the gate encodes the invariant, not the instances.

display_fixes._readme: Label-only corrections: suffixes stripped upstream for players whose identity was never ambiguous (single person in the dataset). No season splits; person_id is the slug of the corrected name.

comeback_allowlist._readme: Single identities with a >=4-year season gap that were individually reviewed and confirmed as one person's real career (injury, retirement, or years overseas). The QA gate fails on any gap not listed here and not covered by a registered split.
comeback_allowlist.Charles Smith: verified single identity (b. Aug 1975); gaps are real absences, not a second player
comeback_allowlist.Udonis Haslem: end-of-bench veteran years 2018-2020 fall below the dataset's minutes bar; one continuous career
comeback_allowlist.John Lucas: cut by Houston Oct 2007; Benetton Treviso/TAU Ceramica/Shanghai 2007-2010; returned to NBA with Chicago 2010-11/2011-12
